objective: Implement offline threat-based security and dependency adapters: tracked source secret-pattern scanning, GitHub action pin audit, pinned dependency inventory, structured vulnerability/license/static-analysis evidence intake, and expiring owned exceptions without false clean claims.
nonGoals: No automatic third-party scanner installation, network lookup, package download or scanner execution
No claim that regex secret scans, self-declared evidence, or stale vulnerability databases prove complete security
No changes to protected GitHub workflows, rulesets or other repositories
No automatic security exception approval, merge, release or deployment
No requirements to purchase external scanning services
decisions: Read-only offline scanner configuration; missing scanner coverage remains unknown, nonempty findings cannot be accepted as clean; exception declarations are not approval signatures

obligations.description: Validate strict policy and tracked source scope; deny traversal/symlink escape, malformed/oversized inputs, weak/expired policy and unscoped control changes.
Discover seeded fake secrets, audit SHA-pinned GitHub action refs and explicit Python requirement pins with negative fixtures and bounded data.

Ingest source/digest bound scanner records for dependency vulnerabilities, licenses and static analysis; reject observed failures and report missing/stale/incomplete scanner/database as unknown, never success.
Require owned/scoped/reasoned expiring exceptions; expired, unmatched or unauthorized exception declarations cannot hide blockers or forge acceptance.
Preserve existing command execution and CI; no automatic network, privileged side effects, merger/deployment or workflow mutation.

structure: src/sf/security.py: read-only scan policy validation, Git inventory, built-in checks, evidence adapters and exception disposition
src/sf/cli.py: explicit sf security assess subcommand
tests/test_security.py: isolated synthetic Git repos and adversarial security/availability fixtures
impact: Add opt-in, offline risk-based security assessment without changing existing profile/assurance semantics
Scanner reports remain observations, provider authorization distinct; findings and unknown coverage surfaced separately
Sensitive matched values must not be present in output; hashes are identity not authentication

budget.network: No live scanner download, network/database update or external application execution; tests local first
budget.execution: One stable pull-request CI run; rerun only for corrective source changes

externalEffects: No merge before PR #22 integration checkpoint and explicit acceptance
No GitHub Actions workflow/ruleset modifications, merge-queue entry or deployment
No source-bot changes or external project writes
